modules.name: 授权核心与数据库策略执行（Authorization + app-plugin-authorization）
modules.scope: 数据库 collection 授权、字段与记录范围、复合业务动作、permission set 组合，以及应用侧文档库声明。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖所有 relation 写路径、复杂嵌套 scope 的运行时组合；未独立执行授权单元测试，只核对实现与原始 QA。

requirements.need: 资料员/阅读者只能看到并操作各自责任范围内的资料，且允许/拒绝必须由服务端真实执行。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 grant、record access、字段策略和数据库 authorizer；应用声明资料范围与角色。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineDatabasePermission 声明 collection 动作与字段，用 defineRecordAccess 声明 owner/published/confidential 过滤，并在服务端路由调用 authz.database.authorize。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用按 Skill 声明了 ownOrPublished/publishedPublic/nonConfidential、documents 复合资源和三个 permission set；B01/B02 的真实 UI 请求通过。

requirements.need: 管理员、资料员、阅读者的页面入口与业务动作分离，阅读者不能通过编辑/创建接口绕过 UI。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 action/page/composite 权限和 deny 路径；应用决定角色矩阵。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 把业务动作声明为 composite action，绑定字段级数据库权限，并用 authorize（而非仅 UI can）保护路由。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用声明 documents.admin/maintainer/reader，记录范围与 restriction 前缀绑定在 permission set；verify-2/3 中阅读者编辑、创建、管理入口均被拒绝。

requirementFit.reason: record access、字段策略、复合动作与数据库 authorizer 直接覆盖 B01/B02/B04；应用只声明业务范围和角色，不需要自行实现授权判定。

usability.reason: fluent builder 和 permission set 组合较一致，未知资源/字段/动作有明确 deny 原因；代价是文档库场景仍需较多应用声明和一次 transaction 编排。

agentFriendliness.reason: 授权 Skill 给出从责任矩阵到声明、路由保护、验证的完整顺序，并指向 runtime/core API；日志显示 Agent 能据此找到入口，但仍需多次探索声明路径。

design.reason: 核心把 resource type、composite、record access、constraints、subjects 分成独立 registry，公开 builder 与执行路径边界清晰。

reliability.reason: authorizer 对未知资源/动作、未知字段、无 grant、无 record access 均返回 deny，并在同一请求内折叠 grant/constraint；实现与真实 allow/deny 结果一致。

modules.name: 共享、限制与默认访问规则（Authz rule plugins）
modules.scope: 单记录共享、restriction 收窄、默认访问规则及其在文档库中的组合与管理接口。
modules.limitations: 未验证高并发下规则变更与已缓存客户端权限的交互；规则 mutation 不广播 permissions-changed，本次只确认下一请求会重新求值。

requirements.need: 把单份私有草稿临时共享给阅读者，撤销后该阅读者不能继续看到。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 sharing rule 的 expand 语义、具体记录 selection 和管理路由；应用提供选择 UI 与清理规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 创建 resource 为 composite、subject 为用户、selection 为 records 的 sharing rule；撤销用删除规则，下一次请求重新求值。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用通过 /authorization/sharingRules 创建/删除单记录规则，B03 刷新/重查后私有草稿消失；未自行扩展授权绕过。

requirements.need: 即使保密资料被共享，阅读者仍不得看到；restriction 必须覆盖共享的 expand 结果。
requirements.responsibility: 框架保证 expand/restrict 组合顺序并执行 restriction resolver；应用声明保密范围。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 restrictionRulesPlugin 的 restrict/bySubject 规则在 grants、default access、sharing 之后收窄；应用把 confidential=false 作为限制范围。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用为 reader 创建 non-confidential restriction 前缀规则；B04 中即使 C 被 sharing，阅读者列表仍无 C，资料员可读。

requirements.need: 默认访问规则应能与显式 grant、共享组合，而不是绕过或重复资源。
requirements.responsibility: 框架定义 default access 的 expand 语义与 one-per-resource 冲突；应用决定是否采用。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按需安装 default-access；同一资源只保留一条规则，资源重复时处理 DefaultAccessConflictError。
requirements.actualUsage: 插件已安装但文档库公开读取主要走 permission set 的 publishedPublic record access，没有强行用 default access；这是正常组合而非缺失。

requirementFit.reason: sharing 的 expand + restriction 的 restrict 直接满足单记录共享、撤销和保密优先；默认访问也能与显式范围共存。

usability.reason: 规则 HTTP API 与设置项接入直接，selection 限制避免“共享全部”；但管理 UI 需自行组装，且规则变更不会主动通知已加载的客户端。

agentFriendliness.reason: 共享 Skill 明确组合顺序、先有 grants、不能 all records 等前提，Agent 能据此实现并解释 B03/B04。

design.reason: 规则服务以 effect/bySubject/allowAll/onePerResource 参数化，三个插件共享同一 RuleService；授权核心只暴露 constraints 扩展点。

reliability.reason: 规则键、资源、actions、scope 均校验，删除/更新走数据库事务；本次 B03/B04 的 allow/deny 与组合顺序一致。未把缺少变更广播误判为安全缺陷。

modules.name: 用户停用与会话失效（Users + Authentication）
modules.scope: 停用账号、撤销全部已有会话、阻止停用后重新登录，以及文档库自定义人员页对这些能力的接入。
modules.limitations: 未检查 API key、service account 或 realtime 长连接的全部边界；未在冻结快照上重新执行停用流程。

requirements.need: 停用阅读者乙后，乙已有会话立即不能访问，重新登录被拒；资料员甲不受影响。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 disable/enable、disabledAt、session 删除与登录拒绝；应用负责在自建人员页暴露状态、操作和授权。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 调用 Users 的 POST /api/users/:userId/disable；disable 内部写 disabledAt 并 revokeSessions；人员页读取 disabledAt 并为管理员授予 user disable/enable。
requirements.actualUsage: 第二轮应用人员页只有 Manage roles，未暴露停用/状态且 documents.admin 无 user disable/enable，B05 失败；修复轮接入既有接口后第三轮通过。

requirements.need: 停用后重新登录必须被拒绝，而不仅是 UI 隐藏。
requirements.responsibility: 框架在 session 创建与请求认证路径检查 disabledAt；应用不得自行删除会话或复制底层存储。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 复用 Authentication 的 disable/revokeSessions 与 session hook，不新增停用端点。
requirements.actualUsage: 修复后的页面调用既有 disable/enable；第三轮验证原会话刷新跳登录、重新登录提示 This account is disabled。

requirementFit.reason: Users 的 disable 路由与 Authentication 的 disabledAt/revokeSessions/session hook 直接满足停用、会话失效和登录拒绝，无需应用自行实现安全机制。

usability.reason: 一个 disable 调用同时处理状态、会话和 realtime 断开，路由语义清楚；但插件不提供管理页面，应用需自行组装 UI 和授权。

agentFriendliness.reason: Users Skill 明确“没有用户管理页”、列出全部 HTTP API 并说明管理员需显式授予 user action；第二轮 Agent 仍未把账号生命周期纳入页面，说明自建页面仍需更明确的清单，但入口本身可发现。

design.reason: Users 负责管理事务与角色范围，Authentication 负责身份/session 语义；disable 复用底层用户存储和 permission set 可移除检查，边界清晰。

reliability.reason: disable 在事务中写入 disabledAt 并 revokeSessions，session create hook 对 disabledAt 与 service account 再校验；第三轮原会话和重新登录均被拒绝。

modules.name: 应用运行时装配与 Provider 生命周期（App server + service provider + guidance）
modules.scope: 应用自有 provider/routes 如何从 runtime 装配，以及 provider 在部分插件集合中启动时的依赖处理。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖全部插件组合与多进程启动；对指引缺口的判断基于冻结测试、retro 与应用 guard，未重新运行该测试。

requirements.need: 文档库的 provider、路由和授权声明必须在应用启动时可靠注册，且在测试/部分插件运行时中不整体崩溃。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责贡献收集与 provider 阶段编排；指引应说明应用 provider 对可选插件服务的依赖前提；应用决定哪些能力是必需。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 把 provider/routes 加入 runtime contributions；在 boot 中解析其他服务。当前指引未说明部分插件运行时需用 container.has 保护可选 token。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 provider 最初无条件解析 authorizationToken，模板 runtime 测试因缺少授权插件抛 Service is not registered；修复轮加 container.has 后通过，并在注释中记录该前提。

requirements.need: provider 注册失败或阶段顺序错误应可诊断，不能静默跳过。
requirements.responsibility: 框架维护阶段状态、重复 name 检查与失败 shutdown；应用负责自身 boot 的异常处理。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 register→boot→start 分阶段，register 只绑定 token，boot 做依赖服务的装配。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用按阶段注册 provider，修复后 boot 先检查 authorization 服务；路由在 token 缺失时返回空 Hono 路由，完整插件集行为不变。

requirementFit.reason: Application 能收集 plugin/runtime 的 provider、路由与 locale，Registry 按阶段启动；文档库 provider 可正常装配，只需在可选依赖缺失时 guard。

usability.reason: 阶段和贡献入口明确，失败会进入 failed 并 shutdown；但部分插件运行时缺少 token 时没有默认可选解析或更直接的诊断，应用需自己写 guard。

agentFriendliness.reason: services-and-jobs 指引完整描述 register/boot 与解析服务，却未提醒模板 runtime 测试会用部分插件集合装配，Agent 只能在启动失败后从错误反推 container.has。

design.reason: Application 只负责收集贡献，ServiceProviderRegistry 独立管理阶段、重复注册和失败清理，职责分离清楚。

reliability.reason: Registry 对阶段错用、重复 provider name 和启动失败有明确处理；本次失败来自应用未保护可选服务，而非启动编排失效。

findings.title: 授权组合能直接表达文档库的角色、记录范围与保密收窄
findings.detail: Authorization 的 record access/composite/permission set 与 sharing/restriction 插件形成可组合路径：应用声明业务范围和角色，框架在数据库 authorizer 与请求上下文中执行 allow/deny。B01-B04 的真实 UI 验收均通过，包括共享后可见、撤销后不可见、保密资料即使被共享仍被 restriction 拦截。
findings.impact: 应用无需自写一套旁路权限检查；框架承担了 grant 组合、字段校验、记录范围与 restriction 顺序。
findings.suggestedChange: 无需修改；后续指引可继续把这个“permission set + record access + sharing/restriction”组合作为企业文档场景示例。

findings.title: 自建“人员与角色”页最初遗漏账号停用与会话失效入口
findings.detail: 第二轮管理员页面每行只有 Manage roles，没有 disabledAt 状态、停用/启用操作，documents.admin 也没有 user disable/enable 授权；因此 B05 无法执行或验证。Users 插件本身已有 disable + revokeSessions，问题在应用页面与授权未接上。
findings.impact: 离职阅读者的既有会话无法通过管理 UI 失效，安全需求 B05 在第二轮失败；这是应用接入缺口，不是框架能力缺失。
findings.suggestedChange: 已在修复轮补齐 disabledAt 展示、停用确认、启用操作与 documents.admin 的 user disable/enable 授权，并复用既有 POST /api/users/:userId/disable|enable。

diagnosis.trigger: 第二轮在 Document administration > People and roles 检查 Yi Reader 行、Manage roles 对话框、Sharing rules 和账户菜单，均无停用账号入口。
diagnosis.expected: 管理员页面应显示账号状态，并能对待离职用户执行停用；停用后所有现有会话失效且不能重新登录。
diagnosis.actual: 页面只管理文档角色，用户列表不含 disabledAt，管理员 permission set 未授予 user disable/enable；B05 报告 failed。
diagnosis.workaround: 修复轮把页面接到 Users 的既有 disable/enable 接口，并在事务/权限层复用插件实现；未新增重复停用端点或自行删会话。
diagnosis.acceptance: 第三轮 B05 通过：管理员停用乙后，乙原会话刷新跳转登录页、重新登录提示账号已停用，甲仍可登录并看到原有资料；documents.admin 同时拥有 disable/enable 且没有 user read。

findings.title: 应用开发指引未说明部分插件运行时需保护可选插件 token
findings.detail: services-and-jobs 指引展示了 provider 在 register 绑定 token、boot 解析其他服务，以及注册/启动阶段，但没有说明模板 runtime/provider 测试会只装配一个 testing plugin；此时应用 provider 若假定 authorizationToken 一定存在，会在 boot 抛 Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered。冻结应用在修复轮才通过 app.container.has 判断和空路由规避。
findings.impact: 按现有指引实现的 provider 会在模板 runtime 测试中整体启动失败，排查者需要从错误反推可选依赖处理；应用侧可绕过，但缺少统一的公开约定。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 services-and-jobs 或 server-routes 参考中补充：应用 provider/路由解析插件所有的可选 token 前先 app.container.has(token)，并点名 tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 的部分插件 runtime 测试；同时说明必需依赖应显式失败而非静默跳过。

diagnosis.trigger: 模板 runtime 测试注入 testing plugin 并保留 appRuntime.serviceProviders，使 DocumentsProvider 在缺少 Authorization 插件的环境中 boot。
diagnosis.expected: 指引应给出可选插件 token 的保护方式和测试前提，让应用在部分插件运行时能启动，同时保留完整插件集下的授权注册。
diagnosis.actual: 指引只描述 register/boot 生命周期和一般性 resolve；应用最初无条件 resolve authorizationToken，测试报 Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered，修复轮才加 has guard。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用在 boot 用 container.has(authorizationToken) 跳过授权注册，并在路由工厂缺少 authentication/authorization token 时返回空 Hono 路由；代价是代码需自行判断哪些能力可选。
diagnosis.acceptance: 未来在只含 non-auth testing plugin 的 runtime 中，应用启动不再抛未注册服务，application-owned /test-runtime 路由仍返回 200；完整插件集下 /api/documents 仍挂载并返回 401。

feedbackReview.reason: 服务与后台任务指引只展示 provider 的 register/boot、容器解析和生命周期，没有说明部分插件 runtime 会缺失 authorizationToken，也没有点名 app-server 的 runtime 测试用空插件列表装配应用 provider。测试与当前 provider/route 的 has guard 共同支持该改进点。Scheduler 文档虽已示例 container.has，但仅限插件专属的可选集成，未覆盖主应用 provider 在测试 runtime 中的通用前提，因此不足以推翻本条，只把结论缩窄为“主应用 provider 指引缺少测试前提与通用守卫说明”。

checks.reason: services-and-jobs 把 provider 职责写成 register 绑定 token、boot 处理需要其他服务的工作，并示例 app.container.resolve；它没有承诺所有插件 token 在每个 runtime 都存在，也没有可选 token 守卫或测试前提。这里应作为指引缺口而不是 API 违约：容器负责装配，应用负责判断哪些集成是可选的。

E61 的测试保留 appRuntime.serviceProviders，同时把 plugins 置空并只创建一个 testing plugin；E72 表明该 serviceProviders 只含 DocumentsProvider，所以 boot 会在没有 authorizationToken 的容器中执行。E45 显示当前 boot 用 container.has 跳过授权注册，E62 记录修复前无条件 resolve 会报 not registered。该改进项不要求用运行时失败来证明，但实际代码与修复路径和结论一致。
应用在 DocumentsProvider.boot 和文档路由工厂中用 container.has 显式跳过，前者在 E45，后者在 E71；这是修复轮加入的绕过，不是应用误用公开 API 或遗漏业务逻辑。问题在于模板测试的空插件前提没有被主开发指引写明，而应用代码已按该前提装配。

processNotes.summary: 修复轮：先修复文档 provider/路由在无插件运行时启动失败；随后修复“人员与角色”页缺少停用账号能力：页面只做角色管理，用户列表未带账号状态，管理员权限集也未授予 user disable/enable，导致离职读者无法停用且已有会话无法失效。现由 Users 插件在停用时统一删除会话，并补齐页面状态、停用/启用操作、授权、双语与测试。

blockers.title: 无插件的应用运行时启动时报 Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts > registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime 在 DocumentsProvider.boot 解析 authorizationToken 时抛错；同一文件中的文档路由工厂也直接解析 authenticationToken 与 authorizationToken。
blockers.rootCause: DocumentsProvider.boot 和 server/routes/documents.ts 无条件解析插件所有的 authenticationToken/authorizationToken。模板运行时测试用空插件列表组装真实应用运行时，boot 阶段因此抛错，路由挂载阶段也会同样失败。
blockers.resolution: server/providers/documents.ts 的 boot() 先用 app.container.has(authorizationToken) 判断，缺失时跳过文档授权注册；server/routes/documents.ts 在 authenticationToken 或 authorizationToken 缺失时返回空 Hono 路由。完整插件集下行为不变：临时用真实 embedded 应用验证 GET /api/documents 返回 401（路由已挂载、需登录），并重跑 tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 与 tests/logic/documents-authorization.test.ts 全部通过。

blockers.title: “人员与角色”页没有停用账号操作，离职读者无法被停用且已有会话不会立即失效
blockers.symptom: 管理员在 /settings/documents 的“人员与角色”中只能管理文档角色，无法停用即将离职的读者 Yi；页面也不显示账号是否已停用。即使直接调用 Users 插件，文档管理员权限集没有 user disable/enable 授权，会被 403 拒绝。
blockers.rootCause: 应用自建的 People and roles 页面只覆盖角色分配与共享规则，遗漏了账号生命周期；后台用户列表查询、响应 schema 和客户端类型都未包含 disabledAt；文档管理员权限集只授予文档/设置权限。Users 插件已有 disable(userId) 能力（写入 disabledAt、删除全部 Session、断开 realtime、禁止后续登录），但页面和授权都没有接上，因此该安全需求无法通过 UI 完成。
blockers.resolution: 在 People and roles 增加 Account 状态列和行操作：停用前弹出确认，停用后显示 Disabled 并可直接重新启用；调用既有规范接口 POST /api/users/:userId/disable|enable，不新增重复的停用端点，也不自行删除会话。扩展 DocumentRoleAssignment/documentUserSchema/DocumentRoleUser 的 disabledAt；为 documents.admin 授予 { type: "user", id: "*" } 的 disable/enable；隐藏当前登录账号的停用入口，补充中英文文案和成功/失败提示。新增组件测试覆盖停用流程，并在权限集测试中断言管理员拥有 disable/enable 且不获得 read。

improvements.title: 文档应说明应用 provider/路由必须容忍插件服务缺失
improvements.detail: 模板的 tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 会用空插件列表组装真实应用运行时，应用自有 provider 或路由工厂一旦在 boot/挂载阶段解析插件所有的服务 token 就整体失败；这一约束在现有 Skill 中未写明，只有踩到测试失败时才暴露。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-app-development 的 services-and-jobs 或 server-routes 参考中加一段：应用 provider 与路由工厂在解析插件所有 token 前使用 app.container.has(token)，并点名 tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 的运行时测试会强制这一点。

improvements.title: 自定义用户管理页应复用 Users 插件账号生命周期并显式授予 user action
improvements.detail: People and roles 这类自建页面容易只实现角色分配，却遗漏停用、启用、会话失效等账号状态；Users 插件已提供 disable/enable（disable 会删除全部 Session），但角色必须在 { type: "user", id: "*" } 上显式获得对应 action，否则页面按钮会遇到 403。现有 Skill 说明了权限授予，但没有把“停用账号会立即注销所有会话”与自建人员页的验收项联系起来。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-app-plugin-users 的 Skill 中补充自建人员管理页清单：读取并展示 disabledAt、使用 POST /api/users/:userId/disable|enable、为管理角色授予 user disable/enable、确认停用会立即删除所有会话，并测试停用后原会话失效。

name: nocobase-app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules
description: Design, implement and verify sharing rules for NocoBase 3 business operations, including named data scopes and production administration.
---

# Develop sharing rules

A sharing rule adds selected records, or a record access selection, for the subjects it lists, provided they already hold the action. Sharing does not grant the operation, fields, page access or related records, and it cannot select all records. Grants, default access and sharing combine first; restriction rules then narrow the result.

Read the installed `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill first for composite resources, data scopes, fields, server policy enforcement and inherited subjects. The package README at `node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules/README.md` is the complete reference for the service, the HTTP routes and the exports; this Skill covers how to use them.

For sharing between departments, read the application development Skill's `references/organization/permission-design.md` first. A rule whose recipient is a department shares specific records with it; a viewer-relative department scope such as 本部门及下属部门 is computed for the viewer and cannot select another department's records. The guide's optional sharing section covers this plugin, and its core section says what remains with permission sets alone.

## Development workflow

1. Identify the real collaboration exception: who receives which records, for which actions, and why. Use explicit records for one handover; use a record access selection for a maintained region or team rule.
2. Grant the recipients the business action through a permission set first. Register inherited subjects and their active membership resolver through the main authorization Skill.
3. Inspect every data scope the operation requires. Quote submission needs the selected quote and its actual parent project. Add each action and data scope deliberately; view, edit and submit are different permissions.
4. Save a complete rule through the HTTP routes or the service. Keep record ids tied to their data scope's collection and preserve the other entries on update.
5. Verify the handover works, an unshared parent still blocks the workflow, restrictions still exclude confidential records, and sharing alone cannot activate a missing operation.
6. Revoke the recipient or the team's permission set and verify the next request loses only that source. Independent direct-user sharing and direct assignments must survive.

For example, a quote handover shares quote edit and submit plus the parent project's submit scope with a delegated engineer. Use the real record ids, never sample ones.

## Install

Register the default export of `@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules/client` in `client/plugins.ts` and of `@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules/server` in `server/plugins.ts`, beside the main authorization plugin, and run the application's migrations. Add the factory to the `plugins` of `server/config/authorization.ts`, merged with the application's other rule factories:

```ts
import { sharingRules } from '@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules/server';
import {
  defineAppConfig,
  type AppConfigFactory,
} from '@nocobase/app-server/config';
import type { AuthorizationConfig } from '@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server';

const authorization: AppConfigFactory<AuthorizationConfig> = defineAppConfig(
  () => ({ plugins: [sharingRules()] }),
);
export default authorization;
```

During setup the factory registers the settings item `authorization.sharing-rules` (group `authorization`, actions `read`, `create`, `update`, `delete`) and its routes under `/api/authorization/sharingRules`, which the running application documents at `/api/swagger/docs` under the `Authorization` tag. Without the factory in the configuration the plugin adds no API and no route.

## Service API

Resolve `authorizationToken` from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server` in the owning provider or route factory. The rule API exists only when the factory is configured, so narrow the service before using it. `quotes` is the application's own composite and `org.team` its own subject type, both defined as the main Skill describes.

```ts
import { selection } from '@nocobase/authorization/core';
import {
  defineSharingRule,
  type SharingRulesAuthorizationApi,
} from '@nocobase/authorization/sharing-rules';
import type { DatabaseConnection } from '@nocobase/db';

if (!('sharingRules' in authz))
  throw new Error('Sharing rules is not configured');
const rules = (
  authz as typeof authz & SharingRulesAuthorizationApi<DatabaseConnection>
).sharingRules;

await rules.create(
  defineSharingRule('proposal-handover', quotes.reference())
    .title('Proposal handover')
    .subjects({ type: 'org.team', id: 'proposal' })
    .scope('edit', 'quotes', selection.records(['quote-7']))
    .scope('submit', 'quotes', selection.records(['quote-7']))
    .scope('submit', 'projects', selection.records(['project-3']))
    .reason('Delegate this proposal to the team')
    .build(),
);
```

A rule is `{ key, resource, actions, title?, subjects, reason? }` and each action is `{ action, scopeKey?, selection }`, where `selection` is `selection.records(ids)` or `selection.recordAccess(key, params?)`; `all` is refused. `create`, `update(key, rule)`, `delete(key)`, `get(key)`, `list()` and `withTransaction(connection)` validate before writing. A rule on a composite names the data scope in `scopeKey` and affects only that composite action's branch; a rule on a `database.collection` omits `scopeKey` and applies across every branch that reaches the collection. Neither form shares related records implicitly or replaces field and relation capabilities, and unrestricted identities skip every rule.

The service is a trusted provisioning API. A custom HTTP caller must check the settings item with `requireSettings(authorization, 'authorization.sharing-rules', action)` and validate the rule with `validateDataScopeRule`, both from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server/extension`, as this plugin's own handler does. Through HTTP, a rule key may not be `options`, `subjects` or `records` (`RuleKeyInput`) and `SubjectsInput`, which refuses a subject listed twice, and a create or rename to a key another rule already uses answers `409 RULE_ALREADY_EXISTS`; a handler of its own gets the same with `assertRuleKeyAvailable` and `rethrowRuleConflict`.

## Installation seeds

Use this only after confirming the plugin is installed, registered and configured and its migrations have run. Read the main authorization Skill's `references/code-and-seeds.md` for `defineSeed`, the restricted seed context and the code/configuration boundary. Seeded rules are ordinary configuration that administrators keep editing; do not protect or re-apply them.

Build the rule with `defineSharingRule` in a portable seed-data module and persist it in two tables:

| Table                                 | Columns                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `authorizationSharingRules`           | `id`, unique `key`, `title` (`encodeAuthorizationTitle`), `resourceType`, `resourceId`, JSON `actions`, `reason`, timestamps |
| `authorizationSharingRuleAssignments` | `id`, `sharingRuleId`, `subjectType`, `subjectId`, `createdAt`                                                               |

`sharingRuleId` references the rule row's `id`; a fresh seed may use the key as the id, but a rerun must use the existing row's id. Each `.subjects(...)` entry becomes an assignment row, not part of `actions`. Create the referenced principals, teams and business records first, check the key and each rule/subject pair before inserting, and write the rule with its assignments in one transaction.

## Administration and acceptance

The plugin contributes no page; an application that edits these rules builds its page on the HTTP routes, which are listed in the package README and each checks `settings:authorization.sharing-rules` with `read`, `create`, `update` or `delete`. Reading options never grants write access.

Run the owning feature's route and policy tests for allowed and denied records, multiple grants and rule removal. Verify changes with a new request and inspect the same operation with `POST /api/authorization/inspector/decide`; a client snapshot does not prove that a row operation is allowed. Report the rules and subjects changed and the observed allow and deny outcomes.

Choose delivery by installation state: use seeds for fresh-install defaults and authorized runtime services or a controlled data-change workflow for an existing installation. These are ways to apply configuration, not alternatives to model development. Reuse current management pages and editors. When the App owns a role editor, build it from the UI Library's `permission-editor` component (`yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/permission-editor`; its example is `@nocobase/permission-editor-demo`), mapping the registered business actions and levels to its sections and rows. Read the relevant references as needed, beginning with the business workflow for model changes and the service/configuration references for configuration changes.

## Start from business responsibilities

Before writing grants, turn the requirement into a matrix: actor/job, page, business action, allowed records, readable/writable fields, relation operations and exceptions. Identify who administers assignments separately from who uses the business feature. Ask only about missing decisions that affect access; record concrete assumptions and continue independent modeling work.

Use jobs as permission sets, such as sales engineer or delivery specialist. Ownership, region and assigned projects are record scopes, not extra role names. A person may hold a direct job plus an inherited team job. Define whether revoking one source should preserve the other. Describe each exception as a business fact: a delegated quote, a confidential project, or an active delivery team.

The sales workflow in [the business module workflow](references/business-module.md) separates quote preparation from regional submission responsibility: an engineer can edit their own out-of-region draft but cannot submit it unless the parent project is also accessible. This is a useful model for multi-table operations; copy the responsibility boundary, not its sample ids.

`@nocobase/app-plugin-users/client`. It contributes only the public
  invitation page at `/invite/:token`; there is no user management page.
- Typed API client: `UsersClient` and its types from
  `@nocobase/app-plugin-users/client/user-client`.
- Server contracts: `userManagementServiceToken`,
  `userRoleScopeRegistryToken`, `UserRoleScope`, and related types from
  `@nocobase/app-plugin-users/server/tokens`.
- HTTP API: `GET /api/users` (`page`, `pageSize`, `q`, `status`, `roleScope`, `role`; answers `{ data, meta: { page, pageSize, total } }`), `GET /api/users/options`, `POST /api/users`, `PATCH /api/users/:userId`, `DELETE /api/users/:userId?confirm=true`, `POST /api/users/:userId/disable|enable|resetPassword|revokeSessions`, and `PUT /api/users/:userId/roleScopes/:scope`. The running application documents each one, with request and response schemas, at `/api/swagger/docs` (JSON at `/api/swagger`) under the `Users` tag. Failures use the standard error body; branch on `error.reason`, such as `USER_NOT_FOUND`, `SELF_DELETE_NOT_ALLOWED`, `LAST_ASSIGNMENT` or `USER_EMAIL_CONFLICT`.

Every HTTP route requires Authentication and Authorization. Routes check the `user` record type with one of `read`, `create`, `update`, `disable`, `enable`, `assign-role`, `reset-password`, `revoke-sessions` or `delete`. Account creation checks both `create` and `assign-role`. `delete` is permitted only while an application role scope can clean a deleted user up.

## Register the plugin

1. Register Authentication, Authorization, and then Users in the App's Client
   and Server plugin arrays. The Client factory takes no placement options:
   `users()`.
2. Grant only the `user` actions those roles need, on `{ type: 'user', id: '*' }` because `user` is a record type. The plugin creates no roles and grants no access by itself.
3. For a user management page, build it in the App on `UsersClient` and declare it among the App's own routes with the page access it needs; the plugin ships none.

The invitation page reports results through `useToaster()` from `@nocobase/app-client`, so the App needs the `@nocobase/app-client` that exports it and registers a toaster service, as the templates do: `client/lib/toaster.ts` from the template, and `this.app.container.instance(toasterToken, createToaster())` in the `register()` of `client/service-provider.ts`, with the `Toaster` component mounted in `client/react-providers.ts`. Without the registration nothing throws, but its toasts are only logged to the browser console.

The default `app` permission-set scope is supplied by Users whenever the Authorization plugin's `authorizationToken` is available. Do not copy a user-roles Provider into an application. Set `users.permissionSets: false` to replace the default with an application-owned scope.
